result.stdout:
loupix - LoupixDeck plugin tool

Usage:
  loupix new <Name> [-o <dir>] [--platform All|Windows|Linux|macOS] [--author <name>] [--sdk-version <x.y.z>] [--local-feed <dir>] [--git]
      Create LoupixDeck.Plugin.<Name> against the latest LoupixDeck.PluginSdk.

  loupix pack [--project <dir>] [-o <dir>]
      Validate plugin.json, build, and write the Plugin Store files to dist/
      (<id>-<version>-<platform>.zip, plugin.json, SHA256SUMS).

  loupix install [--project <dir>] [--debug]
      Pack and install into the LoupixDeck plugins folder (--debug: a Debug build's folder).

  loupix --version
